boot.clean_boot_reason: reboot after the Flash-Next A61 kernel soft lockup; no lane server has run on this boot

question: Does the R139 row-invariant fixed-K W8A16 image deliver batch-shape output identity (c1 == c2 == ... == c64) and 168-256-row repeat determinism at the endpoint when the c1 oracle is regenerated from the same image, as the CR1 review specified, instead of being held to the natural-arithmetic R54a oracle?

evidence_base.cr1_review_step_4: experiments/qwen38-27b-b70/notes/2026-09-02-qwen38-fp8-mtp1-c2-identity-review-kernel-census-cr1.md: regenerate the c1 oracle from the invariant build; the frozen oracle is a localization tool, not a requirement
evidence_base.r140_operator_gate: experiments/qwen38-27b-b70/data/2026-09-02-qwen38-fp8-mtp1-fixed-k-endpoint-r140-result.json: production-image kernel passed small/wide, repeat, permutation, and 168-to-200 padding identity; endpoint rejected only on the frozen-oracle 8/12 and a single-server 53.803 tok/s (-1.14% vs R119)
evidence_base.r140_gap: R140 never ran the c1-c64 identity ladder or the medium-prefill repeat probe; the throughput floor aborted the run first
evidence_base.noise_band: control-vs-control drift on this host was about 3% back-to-back and 10% across a session (CR1 R118 section); a single-server 1.14% miss is not decisive

identity.mtp1_draft: group-128 W4A16 draft head with BF16 scales, FP16 target verifier (R62 treatment, unchanged)

run_order: preflight: zero lane containers, both B70s normal, per-card compute and two-card XCCL health, current-boot kernel journal baseline
mtp0-a: same-image MTP0 control, new empty compile cache, pre-canaries, strict natural-512 suite with post-canaries, graceful stop, health and journal postflight
mtp0-b: second same-image MTP0 control with a second empty cache, identical protocol
gate G1 before any MTP1 launch: mtp0-a vs mtp0-b complete token arrays 12/12; mtp0-a becomes the regenerated same-image oracle
mtp1-a: R139 image with the R62 draft-INT4 treatment, new empty cache, pre-canaries, strict suite, post-canaries, graceful stop, postflight
mtp1-b: identical protocol, then the medium-prefill repeat probe (100,168,200,224,250,300 tokens x5, 64 output tokens, 5 logprobs) on the same server before stop
offline: mtp1-a vs mtp1-b, mtp1-a vs mtp0-a, mtp1-b vs mtp0-a, and information-only mtp1-a vs the frozen R54a natural oracle

ladder: one MTP1 server in the frozen R63 configuration; harness regenerates 64 sequential oracles then measures c1,c2,c4,c8,16,32,64 with repeats=1, max_tokens=128, ignore_eos, temperature 0, --return-token-ids --require-output-identity; graceful stop; postflight

gates.G1_same_image_mtp0_repeatability: mtp0-a vs mtp0-b 12/12 complete arrays exact; on failure stop before any MTP1 launch (the kernel is not c1 repeat-deterministic and nothing downstream can pass)
gates.G4_workload: each attempt: 12 rows, natural EOS, zero cached tokens, canaries pass before and after, realistic_final_gate passed
gates.G5_medium_prefill_repeat: at every length one token-ID stream, one token-logprob array, one top-logprob array, zero cached tokens (this is the 168-256-row hole; R62 failed it at 168, 200, 224, 250)
gates.G6_ladder_identity: every complete concurrent output at c1..c64 equals its sequential oracle; harness --require-output-identity exit status 0

performance_recording.reason: the question is identity; a speed decision between an identity-qualified profile and the faster R62/R119 headline belongs to the user
performance_recording.metric: class_balanced_tok_s_1_100_intervals_after_ttft median per MTP1 attempt and the two-attempt center
performance_recording.classification_rule: if identity_qualified and center >= 0.99 * 54.424603 report 'identity-qualified within the noise band of R119'; if identity_qualified and center below that, report 'identity-qualified, speed-regressed by X% vs R119'; otherwise report which gate failed
performance_recording.ladder_aggregate: c64 aggregate tok/s recorded for comparison with R63 (1080.851 candidate, 1061.646 control); not a promoted concurrency speed claim from one server

abort_conditions: any current-boot Xe fault, CAT error, engine reset, coredump, device loss, timeout, or hung stage in the kernel journal or server log after any stage: stop, do not launch another server
either B70 not in normal state, or per-card compute / two-card XCCL health failure before a launch or after a stop
image identity or extension digest mismatch at launch
a server that does not reach /health within 45 minutes of launch (graceful stop, then abort)
on_pass: Record the identity-qualified profile in a note and CURRENT.md; do not change README, neural.download, or LocalMaxxing text; present the speed comparison to the user for the publication decision; preregister an independent-host replay and the fixture-hardening step (CR1 step 5)
on_failure: Record which gate failed with the raw arrays preserved; if G5 or G6 fails while the operator census passes, the residual source is outside the W8A16 GEMM and the next localization target is the first non-GEMM op whose batch shape differs (lm_head FP16 matmul classes, GDN kernels), not another oneDNN geometry
explicitly_not_done: no R146 run, no oneDNN source edit, no new image build
no concurrency speed promotion from the single ladder server
no Flash-Next lane activity on the same boot until this campaign has stopped and postflight is clean
